title: Overflow in a dropped-index query
statement: Let $z$ be a finite bit string and $r$ a natural number. Suppose the binary representation of the length of the encoding of $z$ paired with the binary representation of $r$ has fewer bits than the binary representation of $r$. Then the result of dropping the index from $z$ has default bit $0$ at index $r$, and $r$ is not less than the length of that result.
hypotheses_covered: The binary representation of the encoded string's length is shorter than the binary representation of $r$
